findings.title: Prior blocking brittleness finding resolved - structural parity validation
findings.description: The previous HIGH severity finding about brittle real-policy assertions has been fixed. The test now uses collectTomlRuleIds() to extract rule IDs dynamically from the parsed TOML structure, then asserts that framework output matches those IDs. This decouples the test from specific rule IDs while still validating correct parsing.

findings.title: Prior blocking path traversal finding resolved - upward discovery pattern
findings.description: The previous MEDIUM severity finding about fixed path traversal has been fixed. The findRepoPolicyFixture() function now walks upward from the test directory to discover .opencode/policy.toml, eliminating hardcoded ../../.. coupling to directory layout.

findings.title: Helper functions are well-structured with proper typing
findings.description: The collectTomlRuleIds, isRecord, pathExists, and toTomlPolicy helpers demonstrate good TypeScript practices with explicit return types, type guards, and defensive programming.

findings.title: Test isolation pattern with tempRoots cleanup
findings.description: Good use of afterEach with Promise.all for parallel cleanup of temporary directories. The tempRoots array pattern ensures cleanup even if tests fail.

findings.title: Compat module remains re-export seam per design
findings.description: The compat.ts module continues to re-export from policy-guardrail/policy.ts. This is intentional per the test description (
) and appropriate for the current migration stage.
